name: Vikas Gaikwad
player_statement:
A complete player, Vikas Gaikwad has made a big mark in cricket. With 46 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 39*, with an average of 8.03 and a quick strike rate of 84.52. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 7 sixes and 25 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 71.4 overs, taking 25 wickets at an economy rate of 10.95. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
